Hi Sam —

Thanks again for the productive kickoff earlier this week. To keep contracting moving, we need a compact party/data capture so Legal can assemble the MSA + Order Form and we can map which template exhibits apply. Please see the asks below (we attached a draft Order Form to speed things up):

Key asks from our side (can you confirm by EOD Monday?):
- Official counterparty name and full legal entity for signature (including dba if relevant)
- Primary billing contact (name, email, phone) and purchase order process if applicable
- Signing authority: name, title, and whether e-signature via DocuSign is acceptable
- Residency / data residency flags (US/EEA/APAC) and any export controls we should be aware of
- Any required exhibits (e.g., Exhibit A: Data Processing Addendum, Exhibit B: Hosting/Residency Appendix) — if you have an internal template name, include it

Operational notes for our internal team (cc'd):
- Kimberly — can you triage which exhibits we should auto-bind vs. conditionally attach based on residency?
- Marissa — I'll need the exhibit mapping CSV back so Contracts can populate the orderflow fields.

Attachments included: OrderForm-draft.docx (order-level rates + seat counts).

Sam, if anything here conflicts with your procurement team rhythm, flag it. Ideally we get the party roster + billing contact by Monday so Legal can start redlining the master template and we avoid a pull-forward on billing cadence.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Director, Commercial Operations
